scope: D8 queue ordering, stream loss and stale peer isolation; notification snapshot copying unchanged

source_inspection.producer: Capture generation and copy input before saved/restored PRIMASK; sequence allocation, non-waiting MQ insertion and drop update in one single-HCPU guard
source_inspection.critical_region: Includes RT-Thread full 528-byte packet copy plus queue and scheduling bookkeeping; latency not measured
source_inspection.failure: Every attempted insertion reserves a sequence, including full queue, invalid payload and null queue; failed controls conservatively mark stream loss
source_inspection.receiver: Advance global sequence for all consumed packets; stale only updates stale/pending_gap, never active peer or parser. Defer real loss to next current packet; reconnect clears prior partial and pending gap
source_inspection.diagnostics: Split A1/stats/queue into lines bounded by 94/106/64 bytes even with maximum unsigned values; RT_CONSOLEBUF_SIZE=128
source_inspection.sdk: Current product configuration has no RT_USING_SMP; enabled public send hook installation not found. Precompiled BLE internals not inspected
